title: email.new
description: Payload of an `email.new` event on the `email` stream: one new inbound message, published once. Consumers (docs/workflows/email-pipeline.yaml) read the full message through the gws_gmail_* tools by `id`; the payload only says that it arrived and from whom.

id.description: Provider message id: the Gmail message/thread id, or the Exchange immutable message id. The dedup key, and the key of the message's entry in email-log.json.

from.description: The From header as the mail tools show it (`Name <address>` or a bare address). Null when the provider gave none.

date.description: The Date header (RFC 2822), as the mail tools show it.

labels.description: Gmail label ids. Microsoft 365 synthesises them: UNREAD, INBOX, STARRED, IMPORTANT, then Outlook categories.

threadId.description: Conversation id (Gmail threadId, Exchange conversationId). Optional: the Google sync does not send it.

provider.description: Which workspace provider produced the event. Optional: absent means google.
